preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist of exactly n lowercase Latin alphabet characters.

postconditions.description: The output string t must have the same length as the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(c in s for c in t) and all(s.count(c) == t.count(c) for c in set(s))
postconditions.description: The output string t must contain the same characters as s with the same frequencies.

postconditions.expression: any(all(t[i:j] == t[i:j][::-1] for i in range(len(t)) for j in range(i+1, len(t)+1)) for t in [stdout])
postconditions.description: The output string t must have the maximum possible number of palindromic substrings.
